issues.message: The alpha task asks `observation.verify` to observe whether “storage zone alpha has been inspected.” That checks whether the requested outcome already holds; it does not perform an inspection or establish that the zone has been inspected. Its `execution-report` satisfaction basis therefore cannot support the stated expected effect. Clarify what should be inspected and what result constitutes completion.

The beta task asks `observation.verify` to observe whether “storage zone beta has been inspected.” That checks whether the requested outcome already holds; it does not perform an inspection or establish that the zone has been inspected. Its `execution-report` satisfaction basis therefore cannot support the stated expected effect. Clarify what should be inspected and what result constitutes completion.
